title: Mexican Chocolate Mousse
description: A rich and creamy Mexican-inspired chocolate mousse dessert, combines the velvety texture with the deep flavor of Italian chocolate.
instructions: Melt the velvety chocolate and Italian dark chocolate together in a double boiler, heat to 105°F.
Whisk in the milk until well combined.
Beat the mixture until it's smooth and creamy.
Taste and adjust sweetness if needed.
Pour the mixture into individual serving cups.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or until chilled.
Garnish with chocolate chips if desired.
